# Jensen Innovation

> Jensen Innovation makes small, offline-first apps by Klaus Jensen (Denmark). Its main app is PortalDex, a collection tracker for toys-to-life collectors on iPhone and Android.

PortalDex tracks five collections in one app: Skylanders figures, Skylanders cards, amiibo, Disney Infinity and LEGO Dimensions. It works offline with no account, no ads and no tracking, in 12 languages.

## PortalDex
- [PortalDex app page](https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/): overview, features and FAQ
- [Skylanders collection tracker](https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/skylanders/): Track your Skylanders collection with PortalDex: all six games, 588 catalog entries including variants, traps, vehicles, magic items and creation crystals, with catchphrases, abilities and NFC scanning on Android.
- [Skylanders cards checklist](https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/skylanders-cards/): Skylanders card checklist in the PortalDex app: 1,238 cards — Topps Giants, SWAP Force and Trap Team trading cards, Skylanders Battlecast cards and the cards packed with every figure.
- [Amiibo collection tracker](https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/amiibo/): Track your amiibo collection with PortalDex: 281 amiibo across every series, with release dates, series and format, completion stats and an indicative price guide.
- [Disney infinity collection tracker](https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/disney-infinity/): Track your Disney Infinity collection with PortalDex: 326 items across 1.0, 2.0 and 3.0 — figures, play set pieces, 181 power discs and toy box games.
- [Lego dimensions collection tracker](https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/lego-dimensions/): Track your LEGO Dimensions collection with PortalDex: 352 characters, vehicles and gadgets, every pack, rebuilds and abilities, plus a which-pack-do-I-need guide.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779376140)
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.portaldex.app)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/privacy/)
